results.title: Victor Osimhen Climbs Galatasaray’s All-Time Foreign Scorers List In Turkey
results.description: Victor Osimhen has risen to third place on Galatasaray’s all-time list of highest-scoring foreign players after another impressive performance for the Turkish champions. The Nigeria international scored twice as Galatasaray secured a convincing 4-0 victory over Erzurum FK on Friday night.
